from pathlib import Path
import json,re
root=Path.cwd();report=root/'docs/vernacular/x03-format-evidence.md'
links=[]
for value in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)",report.read_text()):
 if value.startswith(('https:','http:','#')):continue
 target=(report.parent/value.split('#',1)[0]).resolve()
 assert target.exists(),value
 links.append(dict(link=value,target=str(target)))
Path('tests/native/v5-02-x03-b3-evidence/report-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(links,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Validated',len(links),'local report links')
